supporting_objects.name: E_Phase
supporting_objects.declaration:
TYPE E_Phase :
(
    MANUAL := 0,
    WAIT_FEED := 1,
    MOVE_TO_WASH := 2,
    WAIT_WASH := 3,
    MOVE_TO_WEIGHT := 4,
    WAIT_WEIGHT := 5,
    REJECT_WAIT := 6,
    MOVE_TO_FIRING := 7,
    WAIT_FIRING := 8,
    MOVE_TO_OUTPUT := 9,
    OUTPUT_DONE := 10
);
END_TYPE
